title: Position becomes a rotation
purpose: One pair rotates by pω while its length stays one. Apply the positional transform to Q and K.
contract: R(θ)x = (x₀ cosθ − x₁ sinθ, x₀ sinθ + x₁ cosθ)
θ = pω; p = 0,1,2,3; V is unchanged
